questions.stem: X, Y, and Z form a partnership. X invests Rs. 72,000, Y invests Rs. 54,000, and Z invests Rs. 36,000. After 4 months, Y increases his investment by 20%, while Z reduces his investment by 15%. At the end of 1 year, the total profit earned is Rs. 1,08,000. What is Z’s share of the profit?
